posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: WHAT IS IT?In short, it works similar to the Tapology Survivor game in the sense that it continues every week until there's a winner (or in some cases in this game no winner) but instead of picking your fighters, get assigned a random fighter from the upcoming UFC card and hope they win. FORMAT:1) To enter, simply say that you want to enter at the start of a new game. The length of the games depend entirely on how long it takes to either find a winner or eliminate everyone.2) Then, you will randomly be assigned a fighter from the upcoming UFC card. This will be decided by me using this site I found wheeldecide.com and putting all the fighters names on a wheel and going through the list of players one by one and spinning the wheel to decide which fighter they get. I'll make a very low quality video of the draw and post it here to show I'm not deliberately messing with anyone in particular. It might mean that some people end up with the same fighter but that doesn't affect the game as it's more of an everybody fighting for themselves kinda game rather than a head to head game.3) If your randomly assigned fighter wins their fight then you're through to the next round. If their fight get cancelled or postponed then I'll count it as a loss as it would be considered unlucky. Draws and no contests will also count as losses for the same reason. This happens every week until there is only one left and they will be the winner. In a unique twist to make the game as stupid as possible, if everyone eventually goes out, then nobody wins the game and the game will be marked in the record books as "nobody ******* won" or something like that. For example, if there are 2 or 3 people left and they all have losing fighters then nobody wins the game. I feel this also adds weight to the game as you have to be REALLY lucky to be a winner as you literally have to be luckier than every other competitor to be the only one left standing!WHAT DOES THE WINNER GET?A place on the list of winners that will be displayed on the opening post of every new game and their current AV put on the new game poster (see below) in the middle of the horseshow so they effectively become the poster boy/girl/other for the new game!Any questions, just ask! And remember, please don't take this game too seriously! I mean, it's practically a satire of the Survivor Game when you think about it lol!For the sake of record keeping and historical intrigue, here's the link to the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game: 1st Edition that was on a separate thread: https://www.tapology.com/forum/threads/68098

posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: I was saying before that now that this game has become more than just a gimmick that would collapse after a few editions like I originally expected, I really out to take the record keeping side of it more seriously. So what I've done is I've gone through every page of both the threads to work out our list of past winners and how many rounds they lasted. I also figured that it would be cool to have somewhere on the site where you can check them easily at a glance. This game also also got me curious as to what the pick % of someone who made random UFC picks using the wheel method would be. So, to kill both of those birds with one stone, I'd like to introduce you to.....@The WheelOn it's profile info, I'll list all the previous winners for you guys to check at any time! As for the random predictions, I created this separate wheel that I'll spin while going through the card on the account and select whatever option it lands on for each fight. I know there's @OddsBot and @FantasyBot but they pick every event or at least the major ones and I was curious about what it would be for only the UFC. It also gives you someone to directly vent against when the wheel knocks you out the game lol! Should be an interesting little experiment lol! https://wheeldecide.com/index.php?c1=Home+-+KO%2FTKO+-+Round+1&c2=Away+-+KO%2FTKO+-+Round+1&c3=Home+-+Submission+-+Round+1&c4=Away+-+Submission+-+Round+1&c5=Home+-+KO%2FTKO+-+Round+2&c6=Away+-+KO%2FTKO+-+Round+2&c7=Home+-+Submission+-+Round+2&c8=Away+-+Submission+-+Round+2&c9=Home+-+KO%2FTKO+-+Round+3&c10=Away+-+KO%2FTKO+-+Round+3&c11=Home+-+Submission+-+Round+3&c12=Away+-+Submission+-+Round+3&c13=Home+-+KO%2FTKO+-+Round+4&c14=Away+-+KO%2FTKO+-+Round+4&c15=Home+-+Submission+-+Round+4&c16=Away+-+Submission+-+Round+4&c17=Home+-+KO%2FTKO+-+Round+5&c18=Away+-+KO%2FTKO+-+Round+5&c19=Home+-+Submission+-+Round+5&c20=Away+-+Submission+-+Round+5&c21=Home+-+Decision&c22=Away+-+Decision&col=pastel&t=UFC+PICKS&time=5

posts.body: New game, lots of action. 20 players with 7 doubling up on the same fighter so 13 fighters, only 2 of the 14 fights with nobody in this game. In fight 6, Cangrejoruiz and UNDER SURVEILLANCE will be crossing their fingers and hoping for no hometown decision as they have Ed Herman who's taking on Kansas City's own Zac Cummings followed by Schwerindustrie and TARTARA hoping this is the ringing in of The Year Of The Raw Dawg! Xconchris has Bill Algeo in fight 8, the prelim headliner before our 2nd and last break in the main card opener between Clay Guida and Rafa Garcia. Then we get to our biggest fight of the card as we have 2 on 2, head-to-head, tag team action: kushycake and Stephen Terry backing Chris Gutierrez vs. Rigno and Schatte with Pedro Munhoz. Continuing with the 11th fight, CaptnKbec has Ion Cutelaba, then Ayy has Dustin Jacoby before Kkkomboo has Edson Barboza in the co-main. And lastly in the main event both PiggyBank and Ubermacht have Arnold Allen. Should be an interesting card.

posts.body: As I'm sure you all know, as well as for the purposes of the game, I also use this account for various experiments on Tapology. However, through trial and error, I have discovered that if you make a 5 event, 1V1, Head to Head fantasy game and set it to private and select "use bot player" and don't invite anyone, you end up in a 1V1 fantasy game against @FantasyBot who randomly selects a winner for every fight on Tapology. Yes, I know, you're probably wondering how the **** I discovered that little loophole and all I'm gonna say is that it's a very long story! Anyway, that's what I've done! I made a private fantasy game for the next 5 UFC events and won't invite anyone so that @FantasyBot joins and we can see which method of randomly selecting fighters is superior! Will my "random wheel method" win or will @FantasyBot's "coin flip algorithm" method be victorious? When the first event starts and @FantasyBot has joined then I'll post the link to the game so that you lot can keep track of the score! I'm not 100% sure what will happen but I'm sure it'll be a lot of random madness!

I'm basically asking, is this something you'd be interested in seeing each week? Just trying to gauge the potential level of interest for something like that so I know whether to bother or not. posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: @Bellatrix Honestly, Grasso VS Shevchenko being on a fight night card just doesn't sit well with me TBH. I don't mind the concept of having title fights on fight night cards, for instance, any interim title fights could headline a fight night and I'd be fine with that but putting this fight on a fight night and not a PPV just seems disrespectful to me. Particularly as it's Valentina Shevchenko who is one of the best women to ever compete in MMA but also because it's a rematch of one of the biggest upsets in recent memory! If Grasso wins then she'd have taken the belt of off and defended against one of the greats and if Shevchenko wins, then she avenges one of the very few blemishes in her career. If that doesn't warrant a PPV slot then I don't know what does!From the UFC's perspective, I get that they wanted to make a great fight night card as it's the "noche" card on a significant date but they could've just done that by stacking the card with other great fights. Hell, Kevin Holland VS Jack Della Maddalena would've been a great main event by fight night standards! I suppose the only saving grace is that at least this isn't taking place in the Apex otherwise I might've legitimately switched this game to being for Bellator events out of spite!

posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: @Themmahistorian For sure I'll count you in on the next one! As for adding the PFL, I'll leave it for a bit to see how it all plays out tbh. There's been a lot of new signings and announcements and with that comes a lot of hype but personally, I'm a little doubtful as to how sustainable it is long term. I think next year could be exciting with perhaps 3 or 4 really big PPV cards but I don't know how consistently good they're going to be for their fight nights as you say. Plus, the PFL have thrown a **** ton of money at a few big names but if the PPVs don't sell as well as expected, they could really be in the ****. My best guess is that all this cash has primarily come from some large investors and if the PFL fails to rival the UFC among the casual viewership then they'd be likely to pull out of any agreement they have and without them, the PFL won't be able to offer those big money contracts to the big name fighters. If they can't get those big names anymore then I know for sure that casual fans wouldn't watch it simply because the name value of the PFL isn't anywhere near as big as the UFC. For example, I've got a few friends who I'm trying to get into MMA. For almost all off them, this year is the first time they've heard of the PFL. As for the UFC, quite a few thought that the whole ******* sport was called the UFC! That's the stark difference between the value of their brands. The PFL is a firm 2nd in the world of MMA promotions but it's still a very long way off of the UFC and I can't see them rivalling the UFC the same way Pride and then Strikeforce did any time soon. I went off on a bit of a tangent there but long story short, I'll hold off on adding the PFL to this for now but I'll keep an eye on it to see if they can prove me wrong.

posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: @Cozstradamus No worries mate, I'll add you in the next one when this one ends! And it's very easy to play as you literally don't have to do anything! All you have to do is say you want in (which you've already done) and destiny does the rest! Every week, I'll make a video where I run through the list of names of the players and spin a random online wheel that I've put all the fighters on that week's card into and whoever you get drawn with is your fighter for that event. If your randomly assigned fighter wins their fight, you and everyone else with a winning fighter moves onto the next week. If your fighter loses, draws or is in a no-contest or doesn't fight for any reason, you go out. This process happens every week until eaither their is only one person left with a winning fighter or if everyone left has a losing fighter then the wheel is declared the winner! It's purely based on luck and there's no skill involved whatsoever! You get randomly assigned a fighter and hope they win. The next game will start whenever this one ends. In theory a game could go on forever if everyone kept getting winning fighters but from previous games, 4-5 weeks seems to be about avarage. All the updates are in this thread so you can follow along to see how it works. For tonight, there are the 6 people listed above who have been drawn with their fighters and are all hoping their fighter can win to get through. I'll add you in the next game and good luck! * Edited at 02.17.2024, 7:41 PM ET *

Like the Day of Reckoning card, It will be a 1 round game just for that event and if you get a winning fighter then you win and if you get a losing fighter then you lose. I'm going to be a bit busy on Friday evening so I'll make the proper 6th round video on Friday after the weigh ins as it'll be quicker to make and I'll do the one-off UFC 300 one on Thursday when I'll have a bit more time to make it and I think will also save any confusion. posts.body: We talk about a lot of thing in this game. We talk about you guys, we talk about @The Wheel , we talk about what sacrifices we make and we talk about what colour our lucky underwear is. But what about the fighters? Every time you get drawn a fighter, that brave man or woman has to step into a cage and put their safety and potentially life on the line to win a fight. In some cases, as well as winning the fight, they also unknowingly win the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game for one lucky user (not counting when the @The Wheel wins as it's in @The Wheel 's best interests for all the fighters to lose). I decided that it's high time we shone a light on these fighters! So, to commemorate them, I have decided to make a ranking called the "Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame" that forever lists the fighters and who and when they won it for in the comments of it! I have gone through the whole thread and the original thread to find out who these fighters were.So without further ado, here are the fighters in the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame!Jared Gordon - Won the 1st Edition for @Baron Von Rattus Alonzo Menifield - Won the 2nd Edition for @KyleH Tagir Ulanbekov - Won the 3rd Edition for @PiggyBank Arman Tsarukyan - Won the 4th Edition for @PiggyBank Farid Basharat - Won the 6th Edition for @PiggyBank Israel Adesanya - Won the 7th Edition for @Schwerindustrie Martin Buday - Won the 8th Edition for @TARTARA Elizeu Zaleski - Won the 9th Edition for @Xconchris Jailton Almeida - Won the 14th Edition for @CaptnKbec Veronica Hardy - Won the 15th Edition for @Schwerindustrie Jasmine Jasudavicius - Won the 16th Edition for @Drmaxis2 Aiemann Zahabi - Won the 17th Edition for @Baron Von Rattus Magomed Gadzhiyasulov - Won the 20th Edition for @Cozstradamus Obviously this list will be expanded in the future and I will update the ranking accordingly each time. posts.body: @el_guapo Don't worry, I'm running a bit late tonight due to spontaneous drinks with colleagues after work so I haven't made the video yet. I haven't even officially entered my picks on Tapology yet so I'll just give them a once over before making the video.As for anyone asking how to join then basically you just have! I've acknowledged the replies in this thread as being interested so just sit back and see which fighter from tomorrow's UFC card you'll be assigned with. If your randomly assigned fighter wins then you go through to the next round along with everyone else who has a winning fighter. If your fighter loses, draws or the fight is a no-contest or gets cancelled then you're out. We do this each UFC card until there is either one person left or if for instance everyone in that round has a losing fighter then @The Wheel is declared the winner. It's a sort of elimination sweepstake tbh. As for the videos, I only make them for the sake of showing that it's genuinely random and not just me matching random users with random fighters myself. I have a habit of rambling a lot in my videos so I completely understand if anyone doesn't want to sit though an hour of my slightly drunk self ripping into a random prelim fighter so I'll post the matchups in a post after the video so you can see who you've got. posts.body: @Common Don't want to explain Stephens own game to you. But to me, you have to be good about getting entered. After that all you really need to do is check in around this time every fight day. posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: @ITSYAABOYSB I've thought about it but to be honest, while I watch other promotions, I don't really take the time to research fighters in other promotions like I do with UFC fighters. There's enough UFC fighters to try and keep track of anyway these days and a lot of my spare time in the couple of days leading up to the cards are spent familiarising myself with the prelim fighters I don't know much about. Selfishly, it's also partly because the UFC is on most weeks and for the occasional week it isn't, it's quite nice to have a week off from doing it. Where possible, I try to make the videos after the weigh-ins to reduce the chances of people being eliminated though a fight being cancelled due to a weight miss or weight cut complications. The downside with doing this is that in my timezone, the weigh-ins can sometimes be very late in the evening and most of my videos are made around midnight or the early hours of the morning because of it and I work most Saturdays so on my average Friday night, I'm only getting a few hours sleep. Then on Saturday evening, I'll watch the UFC card and that will usually start around 11pm and end at 4am which can be tough when I've barely slept the night before. So yeah, it's nice to have week off sometimes!If you or someone else wanted to try and continue the game with other promotions during the weeks that the UFC isn't on then I'd be happy to let you do that as long as everyone else was happy to do that.

posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: @Kniferusty I'm no philosopher but technically speaking, while it is indeed possible for everyone to be eliminated in the 1st round given an infinite number of games, it isn't inevitable either. It's certainly more likely than not that it will happen given an infinite number of games but it is also possible that every game could coincidentally always end in the 2nd round or more.Basically, while the law of averages suggests it will happen one day, it doesn't make it a certainty either. In theory, there is no guarantee that this particular game will end before the end of humanity, so long as two or more players keep getting winning fighters. * Edited at 03.08.2025, 5:41 PM ET *

posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: @Kkkomboo As flattering as it is that you want us to be an alliance, the most important thing is that someone beats @The Wheel at the end of every game and the more people there are in the game, the higher the chances of that happening are. Personally, I love this whole alliance idea as it adds to the overall ****housery of the game and compliments the game's unserious nature perfectly. However, my love for ****housery is rivaled only by my hatred of @The Wheel and when people double up in an alliance, it reduces the overall number of entrants in the game and, in turn, the overall number of enemies for @The Wheel to eliminate. For example, suppose at the start of every game, everyone of us joined together as one massive alliance against @The Wheel . Our success rate should theoretically be about 50%. As individuals however, 19 of the 27 complete games have been won by real people. This means that about 70% (70.38% to be precise) of the games have been won by real people. From a statistical standpoint, @The Wheel has a higher chance of being defeated if we all fight as individuals.

posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: @Cozstradamus I've taken a couple of days to think about that suggestion and I've come to the conclusion that it would ultimately be a lose-lose situation for everyone involved. Obviously the person who was selected would have an unfair advantage compared to the others just because they were selected to be the Easter Bunny but more importantly, it would take the fun out of it for the person who is selected. The fun of this game is not solely in making it through the rounds but rather, rooting for someone who you might not normally root for or paying more attention to a fight that you otherwise wouldn't necessarily be all that interested in. I'm sure that for our winners, they now have a fondness for the fighter that won them the game and smile a little whenever they see their name pop up on a fight card.One thing I will consider instead if people want is to do the opposite of this and randomly select an eliminated person to re-join the game. After all, Easter is ultimately about celebrating Jesus's resurrection so why not resurrect someone from this game? The idea could also be recycled in a more macabre way for Halloween or the Mexican day of the dead if it proves popular. I'll let you guys vote on it in the next post and if you do like the idea then I'll do the draw for it at the start of the next video. * Edited at 04.21.2025, 6:13 AM ET *

posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: We now come to one of the rare moments of sincerity in this game. For all the agony, joy, laughter and tears that this game brings, it is important to remember that it is only possible due to the brave men and women stepping into the cage and putting their bodies on the line for our entertainment. Behind every Lucky Bastard Game champion, there is a fighter who's been training for years and making tons of sacrifices in order to bring this slither of glory to them. To honour these fighter's, we have the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame! Every fighter who wins a game for one of you lot gets added into it. For winning the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game: 29th Edition for @Rigno , it now gives me great pleasure to add Malcolm Wellmaker as the 20th member of the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame!Here are the 20 fighters now in the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame: Jared GordonAlonzo MenifieldTagir UlanbekovArman TsarukyanFarid BasharatIsrael AdesanyaMartin BudayElizeu ZaleskiJailton AlmeidaVeronica HardyJasmine JasudaviciusAiemann ZahabiMagomed GadzhiyasulovThomas PetersonKai Kara-FranceKaylah HarrisonPunahele SorianoJonathan MicallefCarlos UlbergMalcolm WellmakerIf you want more detail about who they won it for and in what game and round, you can check out the list here:https://www.tapology.com/profiles/steve%20terry/my-rankings/5996-tapology-lucky-bastard-game-hall-of-fame

posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: @ITSYAABOYSB Yeah, maybe if there's another really long gap and there's a big card like the Usyk VS Fury card. I that case, it was over the Christmas break where there was no UFC for about a month and that card was insanely stacked so it made sense. Usually a couple of weeks break between UFC cards where the next biggest event in that non-UFC week is an LFA card or something then it doesn't really warrant it but I'd certainly consider it for other massive non-UFC events. Like the Usyk VS Fury card, it will probably be best just to do something like that as a separate 1 round friendly game with everyone back in rather than as a continuation of the main game.Probably the next biggest thing like that would be the Canelo VS Crawford card in September so I'd be happy to do a one off friendly for that when it rolls around, depending of course if you lot would be interested in that?

posts.body: After 8 gruelling rounds, the longest game in history finally comes to an end! Congratulations to @Foghorn Sam for becoming the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game: 30th Edition Champion! Your patience paid off as you watched everyone else around you get eliminated very slowly while you hung on to survive more rounds in a single game than anyone else before you (seriously, the odds of getting a randomly drawn winning fighter 8 times in a row must be pretty slim!) to claim the first of what I hope will be many Lucky Bastard Game titles in the future! Most importantly, you stopped @The Wheel from winning! As the new champion, you also get the honour of becoming the poster boy for the next game!Speaking of the next game, the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game: 31st Edition is now open! posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: @Bellatrix From a statistical point of view, alliances don't make any sense and actually increase the chances of @The Wheel winning. If hypothetically, we all formed one big alliance at the start of every game then @The Wheel 's win rate would be about 50% give or take a few minor factors like weight misses and draws/no-contests but with everyone fighting as individuals, @The Wheel 's win rate is only 30% (9/30 games) with users winning the other 70% (21/30 games) so working individually is more likely to result in a user winning the game. What these stats don't factor in however is superstition. Some people may feel that some users are naturally luckier than others and have a better chance of winning than others and by forming an alliance with them, they have more chance to win. It also just adds to the overall fun and ****housery of the game which I'm proud to say is probably the most unserious game on Tapology!It basically comes down to would you have more fun teaming up with certain people on here or by going it alone.

posts.author: el_guapo
posts.body: William Gomis goes to an all out battle between him and Polish newcomer Robert Ruchała in the featured prelims with the hometown hero GOMIS taking the judges decision and bouncing back from his split loss to Amil. His win gives the living breathing legend Trig a spot through the next round as he becomes the fifth Bastard to make it on the The Wheels good-side…Axel Sola used his crisp boxing and sharp foot-work to out pace and cut up Cage Warriors legend Rhys McKee, ultimately ends a little bit of a controversial stoppage… although I dont really think McKee was gonna be bouncing back from that 2nd and brutal beginning 3rd. AyyLmaonnaise WINS the lucky bastards main event for this week as he clears past McKee’s trio of BoomShakaLaka, Foghorn Sam & Problem… the number of eliminated grows exponentially! Bolaji Oki empties his gas tank EARLY against the welch dragon Mason Jones and pays for it undoubtedly… Jones throws Oki around for the later parts of Round 1 and the entirety of Round 2 until Oki is left DEFENCELESS on the ground with Jones raining elbows down from the welch heavens and puts record time winner PiggyBank out of his misery with what Oki has left for him. Another bites the dust.Paul Craig goes the dance with UFCs Lithuanian wrecking machine Modestas Bukauskas but jumps the gilly only to be elbowed to death to the canvas (big theme of elbows to grounded opponents, luv to see it!) and ultimately crumbles the chances of Geneva65 & Cheeseball…Benoît Saint-Denis gets his revenge on the Brazilian flag in Fighting Nerds stand-out Mauricio Ruffy as he gets a grinding rear naked choke victory in his home country giving main eventers Borralho & Imavov something to be fired up about! In lighter news, Drmaxis2 & Tosh escape the elimination furnace of The Wheel and makes it though.Caio Borralho takes on The Sniper Nassourdine Imavov in his home country for a shot at greatness but ultimately come short in a 5 round slugfest with him just narrowly falling behind as Imavov proves to be a domineering force within the Middleweight rankings!! Sally that means it is all but over for our dearly beloved XconChris as he is the final one The Wheel drags to hell with the rest of us!!Bastards Saved: 9(10)Bastards Eliminated: 12(14)(Also really glad you got my reference Baron lol)

posts.body: After a shorter (compared to recently) but brutal 4 round game, we have a winner! Congratulations to @kushycake for becoming the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game: 31st Edition Champion! He survived 4 rounds of mass eliminations to be the last one standing and, more importantly, prevent @The Wheel from claiming another victory! With this win, he now becomes a 2 time Lucky Bastard Game Champion, having won the 22nd Edition, coincidentally, also in the 4th round! He also gets the honour of becoming the poster boy for the next game! Speaking of the next game, the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game: 32nd Edition is now open! The following people are lifetime pass holders and have been entered into the game automatically (lifetime pass holders in alliances not included to save me from accidentally adding someone twice): AyyLmaonnaiseBellatrixBoomShakaLakaCalfothCangrejoRuizccollins44CheeseballCoolHandPukeDamienHandel420Drmaxis2 el_guapoFoghorn SamGeneva65ITSYAABOYSBJack SottoKniferustykushycakemulefloydPiggyBankRignoSchatteTheMatchmakerThemmahistorianToshTrail AllmantrigXconchris I have also added in @Spockling , @MMA_Miyagi and @D1D4K10 as they have already asked to play. I have also added in @Themmahistorian and @Siunsix as they have previously said that they want to be a part of any games I run.As for alliances, I'm assuming both @Cozstradamus and @Troz want to play again as "Trozstradamus" and that @Ubermacht and @Schwerindustrie want to play as "Überindustrie" again but if any of you want to split up and compete as individuals then just let me know! @Kkkomboo I've also put us down as "KK Terry" again, assuming you want to continue our alliance but no worries if not, just let me know! If anyone else wants to team up with other users and form alliances then just let me know before I make the first video for the new game!The Tapology Lucky Bastard Game: 32nd Edition will start with "UFC 320: Ankalaev VS Pereira 2" and I'll be making the first video for it at some point on Friday evening so anyone else who wants to play that hasn't already said so has until some point on Friday evening to do so!Do you think you have what it takes to become a Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Champion? Come and have a go if you think you're lucky enough!

posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: Now for a more serious part of the post game ceremonies. While we're all here chatting **** and rooting for the victories and downfalls of certain fighters, it's important to remember that all these fighters we get drawn with and against are real people who are putting their bodies and lives and long term health on the line for our entertainment. They work and train hard and make a ton of sacrifices to become the best they can at beating the **** out of other people (typing sentences like that really make me do a double take of this sport sometimes). Because of this, I like to honour all the fighters that have won the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game for users (not counting when everyone loses and @The Wheel wins) by adding them into the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame! For winning the 31st Edition for @kushycake , it now gives me great pleasure to induct Jack Jenkins into the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame! Here are the 22 fighters now in the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame: Jared GordonAlonzo MenifieldTagir UlanbekovArman TsarukyanFarid BasharatIsrael AdesanyaMartin BudayElizeu ZaleskiJailton AlmeidaVeronica HardyJasmine JasudaviciusAiemann ZahabiMagomed GadzhiyasulovThomas PetersonKai Kara-FranceKaylah HarrisonPunahele SorianoJonathan MicallefCarlos UlbergMalcolm WellmakerKhamzat ChimaevJack JenkinsIf you want more detail about who they won it for and in what game and round, you can check out the list here:https://www.tapology.com/profiles/steve%20terry/my-rankings/5996-tapology-lucky-bastard-game-hall-of-fame

posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: Just a heads up for those who are in the 3rd round, I'm busy this Friday evening which means that I'll have to make the 3rd round video on Thursday evening instead. This means that the video will be made before the weigh-ins and if you're unfortunate enough to be drawn with a fighter whose fight gets cancelled completely or if your assigned fighter has to pull out and can't fight this weekend then that will count as a loss for the purposes of this game on the basis that having that happen to you would be extremely unlucky and only the luckiest can survive in this game. In other words, your fighter has to both fight and win this weekend for you to go through. If your fighter's fight gets changed to a different weight or gets a different opponent but your fighter still competes then it will still work as normal. It's still unlikely to get eliminated via the scales but due to having to make the video before the weigh-ins, it does make this round slightly riskier than normal. Apologies in advance if this does happen to anyone and I always try to make the video after the weigh-ins for this reason but unfortunately, I've got a social event that I simply can't cancel on Friday so we'll just have to take the added risk of the weigh-ins this week.

posts.author: el_guapo
posts.body: Karolina Kowalkiewicz attempts to overcome the odds and strike back against her FAR younger counterpart in this battle in Julia Polastri… sadly for the trio of captain Steven Terry, ccollins44 & my bets luchador pal; CoolHandPuke… Kowalkiewicz ****s the bed in the last moment of the fight as she succumbs to a VICIOUS head kick and hooks combo.Thomas Petersen heads into the all out SLUGFEST war against home country favorite Vitor Petrino with former champ ITSYAABOYSB on his back… however, Petersen throws himself into the flames of Petrino’s strikes late into the fight & eating a brutal right uppercut, falling face first launching ITSYAABOYSB off of him and into The Wheels flames of doom as he takes yet another bastard…Next is a 1v1 Kkkomboo(Filho) vs. Schatte(Carpenter), with Filho getting the better of Carpenter on the grappling EARLY. Clayton fights the control of Jafel for a brief moment… but the pastor proves to both him and the Brazilian crowd that BJJ still has a strangle on the MMA world no matter the prospects. A terrific sign for Kkkomboo! But a rather unfortunate turn of events for 21st edition winner Shatte as he the next victim for The Wheel. Kkkomboo is the first through the 2nd Round.Lucas Almeida breaks the unbeaten streak Brazil was gathering… while Michael Aswell Jr gets his first UFC win, it comes at the cost of Geneva65… looking to be a thin roster next round...

posts.body: Our lucky bastards main event starts with a 5v1, with Kaan Ofli holding the most bastards on his back; he manages to take Ricardo Ramoses in rather quick style. Ramos lets down yet another bastard YET AGAIN as Spockling doesn't survive the 5-Man assault on him with the Gang of trig, Cheeseball, Siunsix, MMA_Miyagi, & Foghorn Sam!!! 5 bastards manages to trick the wheel in our main event!!!Vicente Luque takes on Joel Álvarez that ends up in a brutal forest of punches and grappling that leads him to a unanimous decision loss surprisingly giving Álvarez his FIRST EVER decision victory in his pro career! Team D1-Sotto (sounds like a Star wars droid) OBLITERATES the lonestar Trail Allman to add another bastard body onto the count. Although we've lost 8 bastards… 8 more made it through!Montel “Quik” Jackson comes across his first hurdle in quite awhile as Deiveson Figueiredo rallies back the Brazilian crowd on a close but hard fought battle that comes at a cost for Jackson win streak as well as Team Baron Von Tosh is surgically removed from the competition.Charles Oliviera overwhelms and takes the soul of Polish standout grappler in Mateusz Gamrot with barely any issues or worries as he keeps his name in the tops of the lightweight title discussion. As well as launching the final bastard in mulefloyd to the elite Round 3 alongside the other 8 making it a longer night for the wheel!!!

posts.body: Here at the Lucky Bastard Game, we take all accusations of discrimination very seriously and it has come to my attention that @The Wheel has been accused of being prejudiced against Americans. I have decided to investigate these claims and have made the following table showing the nationalities of all the previous winners (@The Wheel 's own wins excluded of course as @The Wheel was forged in the deepest depths of Hell). These stats are based solely off of what is currently on the profile pages of the users or what I know about them based on previous interactions. In cases where there is no location listed, a joke or fictional location is listed or where Googling the location has resulted in places in multiple countries coming up (for example, @Drmaxis2 has "Red Mountain" listed on his profile which I assume is the one in Canada but it also returned places in the USA with the same name) they have been put into the "Unconfirmed" category. I have also listed the names of the winners and how many times they've won it in brackets.Looking at the table, the USA is the highest ranked confirmed nation for wins however, I'm assuming that the majority of Tapology's users are from the USA so whether the number of wins is proportional to the number of American's who have ever entered the Lucky Bastard Game is up for debate.

posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: @Troz I may be mis-remembering but I think the UFC 300 special game was under the normal rules. IIRC everyone was hyped for UFC 300 and were hoping that a new game would start in time for it but as it happed, we we're in the middle of a game when it came around so we basically put the normal game on hold for a week and just did UFC 300 as a separate 1 round special game. We also did the same thing for that massive Saudi boxing card at Christmas when there wasn't any UFC for about a month. There's also another big Saudi boxing card this Christmas (27th December I think) headlined by Naoya Inoue and Alan Picasso so if there's no UFC that week (which I highly doubt there will be) then we could do another 1 round only Christmas boxing special one again!The only other random thing we did was when we brought a randomly drawn eliminated player back into the game. I usually go to bed about an hour or two after recording the video (usually 2am - 3am depending given I'm often working late on Fridays and my habit of rambling on a lot) and I find that a glass of whisky a couple of hours before bed really helps to bring the energy and thoughts in my head down and makes it easier to rest my mind.

posts.body: In the most unusual game we've ever had with the opposite rules for the 1st round for Halloween and then back to normal up until Christmas, we finally have a winner! Congratulations to @Bellatrix for winning the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game: 33rd Edition! She fought off all the competition and rule changes to defeat @The Wheel and claim her 1st ever Tapology Lucky Bastard Game title! This now means that we have had 5 games in a row since @The Wheel last won, making it the longest winless streak @The Wheel has ever had! (The previous longest losing streak for @The Wheel was 4 games in a row several times before). Hopefully in the next game, we will continue this incredible streak! In the meantime, @Bellatrix gets the honour of becoming the poster girl for the new game! Speaking of the new game, the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game: 34th Edition is now open! The following people have been entered into the game automatically as lifetime pass holders: AyyLmaonnaiseBellatrixBoomShakaLakaCalfothCangrejoRuizccollins44CheeseballCoolHandPukeCozstradamus D1D4K10DamienHandel420Drmaxis2 el_guapoFoghorn SamGeneva65ITSYAABOYSBJack SottoKkkombooKniferustykushycakemulefloydPiggyBankRignoSchatteTheMatchmakerThemmahistorianToshTrailtrigTrozXconchris I've also included @MMAutist and @Spockling as they've already requested to play in the new game and I've also added @Siunsix and @Thedirtyufcman as they've previously said they want to take part in any games I run.As for alliances, I'm assuming that @Ubermacht and @Schwerindustrie want to continue their "Überindustrie" alliance so that's what I've put them down as but if one of you changes your mind and wants to play as an individual then just let me know before the game starts! If anyone else wants to form an alliance then just let me know before I make the video for the 1st round draw!The Tapology Lucky Bastard Game: 34th Edition will start with UFC Fight Night: Royval VS Kape and I'll be making the first video for the new game at some point on Friday evening so anyone else who wants to play but hasn't already entered has until the to do so!Do you have what it takes to defeat @The Wheel and win the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game? posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: Now for the more serious and formal part of the post game ceremonies. While we're all chatting **** and having a laugh at our respective fortunes and misfortunes in this game, the fighters that we're cheering or jeering are putting their bodies on the line for our entertainment. Without their sacrifices, bravery and dedication to this sport, none of this would be possible. When we see so many fights and so many highlights on social media these days, it can be easy to forget that on the right end of those highlights is a person who has worked tirelessly to achieve it and on the wrong end, a person potentially suffering serious injuries while simultaneously having their dreams crushed or at least set back a bit, only to read comments such as "washed up bum", "overrated", "fraud checked" by people who they'd be able to turn into a ******* pringle in real life. To honour these great fighters, whenever one wins a Tapology Lucky Bastard Game for a real user (not including when @The Wheel wins these games), I induct them into the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame! For winning the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game: 33rd Edition for @Bellatrix , it now gives me great honour to induct Fares Ziam into the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame! Here are the 24 fighters now in the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame: Jared GordonAlonzo MenifieldTagir UlanbekovArman TsarukyanFarid BasharatIsrael AdesanyaMartin BudayElizeu ZaleskiJailton AlmeidaVeronica HardyJasmine JasudaviciusAiemann ZahabiMagomed GadzhiyasulovThomas PetersonKai Kara-FranceKaylah HarrisonPunahele SorianoJonathan MicallefCarlos UlbergMalcolm WellmakerKhamzat ChimaevJack JenkinsValter WalkerFares Ziam If you want more detail about who they won it for and in what game and round, you can check out the list here:https://www.tapology.com/profiles/steve%20terry/my-rankings/5996-tapology-lucky-bastard-game-hall-of-fame

posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: As I'm sure you know by now, as a way of paying tribute to the fighters putting their bodies on the line for our entertainment, all fighters that win a final round of a game for a user get added to the Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame. So far, there are 24 people in it with one win each to their names. My prediction for this round is that Jailton Almeida will win and Alex Morono will lose, causing @CoolHandPuke to win the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game: 34th Edition! If my prediction is correct, then Jailton Almeida will become the first and so far only fighter to win two Lucky Bastard Games for users, having previously won it for @TheMatchmaker (going by @CaptnKbec at the time of the win) in the Lucky Bastard Game 14th Edition in the 3rd round!Until about 10 minutes ago, I never even thought about the possibility of a fighter winning two separate Lucky Bastard Games for users given that: A) They have to coincidentally be fighting on a card which coincides with the final round of the gameB) They of course have to be drawn with a user in that round in the first placeC) They have to win their fightD) All the other fighters involved have to lose or get eliminated by no-contest, draw, cancellation etc.Working out the odds for a fighter ending up in these circumstances twice is almost impossible to work out given some fighters are more active than some, some fighters are in a position where they expect to win most fights while others aren't, some fighters will retire or get cut etc but the odds are pretty ******* slim! Will my prediction prove correct and Jailton Almeida makes Lucky Bastard Game history in a way that quite likely won't happen again? We'll find out tomorrow night!Obviously, you can't add the same fighter to a ranking twice so I'd just have to add this win to his current comment if he does!For anyone who wants to scroll through the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame to see which other fighters won it and for who then it can be found here: https://www.tapology.com/profiles/steve%20terry/my-rankings/5996-tapology-lucky-bastard-game-hall-of-fame Again, best of luck to both @CoolHandPuke and @el_guapo !

posts.body: Now for the more serious part of the post game ceremonies. While we're all watching the fights each week while sitting back downing beers, snacks and other assorted artery cloggers, these fighters are putting their bodies and lives on the line for our entertainment while also grinding away in the gym every day to prepare for it. They dedicate the best years of their lives to this sport and without them, this game simply wouldn't be possible. To honour these brave warriors, we add every fighter who wins the final round of a game for a real user to the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame where their names will live on forever, long after casual fans have forgotten them. For winning the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game: 35th Edition in the 4th round for @Schatte , it now gives me great pleasure to officially add Marwan Rahiki to the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame! posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: Speaking of basketball, I have a Reddit account but unlike Tapology which I actually value being a part of, I use my Reddit account for trolling for my own amusement because I don't care if I get banned from there. I don't say anything horrible to anyone personally, I just make intentionally dumb, illogical arguments and double on them when people reply. I also follow pretty much every subreddit I find on there just to see the range of content out there and find opportunities to make dumb comments and one of these was the NBA subreddit which I got permanently banned from a few hours ago. There was a post of a guy called Steven Curry missing some shots during what I think might've been a warm up or something and I commented "He seems like a good player with a lot of potential but he really needs to tighten up his throwing if he's ever going to get a transfer out of the NBA and into the big leagues" and that seemed to get a lot of folks really riled up compared to some of my other efforts and caused mine and most of the replies to get removed. I wasn't expecting that big of a fight to break out so I'm guessing that guy is a big name in the NBA!Anyway, I've now heard of Steven Curry as well bringing the total number of basketball players I can name to 8! He looks like he's got potential, he just needs to tighten up his throwing though lol!

posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: In light of the claims made by @Troz , @Cozstradamus , @qqqqqq , @ITSYAABOYSB and several other American Tapology users of honourable standing regarding an alleged "Anti-American bias" from @The Wheel , I have decided to launch and official inquiry into these accusations. The inquiry will be led by me and features a panel of some of the finest individuals with strong links to both the United Kingdom and The United States of America. To my far right, we have Brad Guzan. Born in Evergreen Park, Illinois, he is a former professional football (soccer) goalkeeper who made 64 appearances for US national team, appearing at two FIFA World Cups and also represented them at the 2008 Summer Olympics. He has also gained a cult hero status over in the UK for his stint playing in England, most notably for Aston Villa, making 144 appearances for them between 2008 and 2016.To my immediate right, we have Ogugua "OG" Anunoby. Born in London, England, he is a basketball player who plays as a small forward/power forward for the New York Knicks in the NBA. He won the 2019 NBA Championship with the Toronto Raptors and was also named in the NBA All-Defensive Team in 2023 after leading the league in steals. He is widely considered to be one of, if not the best British player in NBA history.To my immediate left, we have Mischa Barton. Born in London, England, she is a British and American actress whose career has spanned stage, film and TV. She has most notably starred in major films such as "Notting Hill" and "The Sixth Sense" as well as the TV series "The O.C." along with many other independent projects. She has also ventured into the world of fashion design and has been an ambassador for many charitable organisations such as "Climate Star" as well raising money for women's cancer research.Finally, but by no means least, on my far left we have The Right Honourable Sir Robert Liston (not to be confused with the Scottish surgeon of the same name). Born in Kirkliston, Scotland, he was a British politician who served as the ambassador for many countries, including holding the office of "Envoy Extraordinary and Minister Plenipotentiary to the United States" which was the precursor to the modern role of the "British Ambassador To The United States", a position currently held by Sir Christian Turner. He was also said to have been able to speak 10 different languages which is no mean feat in a world before Duolingo.I have no doubt that this panel of extraordinary individuals will come to a fair and informed conclusion regarding this matter. We openly invite anyone of any nationality to put forward their evidence and arguments for the panel to consider, although we are especially keen to hear from Americans who feel they have been slighted by @The Wheel , not due to natural misfortune as a result of the nature of this game but because of their nationality.

It even thought it could defeat the might of the United States of America but oh, howdy was it wrong! Congratulations to our Tapology Lucky Bastard Game 36th Edition Champions, Jordan & Pippen (@qqqqqq & @Spockling )! They fought off all the competion and earnt their stars and stripes! They also made history by becoming the first ever alliance to win a Tapology Lucky Bastard Game! How fitting it is too that it was an American alliance to win it! After all the anti-American accustions against @The Wheel and the far more serious divisons within the United States of America at the moment, it is fitting that it was two Americans who reminded us that unity is the key to deafeating all evil! Even @The Wheel crumbled in their presence! This gives them the honour of becoming the poster boys for the next edition of the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game! I wasn't sure how to squeeze both of their profile pictures on the poster so I just used a picture of the real life Jordan & Pippen. Speaking of the new game, the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game: 37th Edition is now open! The following people have already been entered as lifetime pass holders AyyLmaonnaise Bellatrix BoomShakaLaka Calfoth CangrejoRuiz ccollins44 Cheeseball chimpsmack Cozstradamus D1D4K10 DamienHandel420 Drmaxis2 el_guapo Foghorn Sam Geneva65 grayerman Great ITSYAABOYSB Jack Sotto Jordan & Pippen (qqqqqq & Spockling's alliance) (You guys do have a lifetime pass already but I'm going to wait until the 4th of July to issue it because issuing your lifetime pass for such an Americanised team on the 4th of July on the 250th anniversary of the USA's independence is just too good an opportunity to pass up!) Kkkomboo KnifeRusty kushycake mulefloyd PiggyBank Rigno Schatte TheMatchmaker Themmahistorian Tosh Trail trig Troz Übermacht Vazke88 Xconchris I have also included @Thedirtyufcman and @siunsix as they have previously asked to play in any games I run. I have also included @Tajhy101 as they have already asked to play in the next one and @Baron Von Rattus as well as he's not technically a lifetime pass holder but he's a regular player as basically is an unofficial lifetime pass holder at this point lol.As for alliances, I'm assuming that our reigning, defending Lucky Bastard Game Champions @qqqqqq and @Spockling want to compete as "Jordan & Pippen" again and I'm assuming that our German alliance of @Ubermacht and @Schwerindustrie will want to enter as "Überindustrie" again but if any of you want to enter as individuals rather than as an alliance, just let me know! If anyone else wants to form a new alliance then just let me know as well!The new game will start with the next UFC event, UFC Fight Night: Sterling VS Zalal and I'll be making the first video for the new game at some point on Friday evening so anyone who wants to enter has until then to do so! If you want in, just say so in the thread and enjoy the ride, it's that simple! Do you have what it takes to win the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game? Come and have a go if you think you're lucky enough!

posts.author: Steve Terry
posts.body: Now, we come to the more serious side of the post game ceremonies. While we are sat behind our keyboards, phones and other digital devices chatting **** about the fighters and bragging about our national pride from whichever corner of the world we dwell, these fighters are out there in the cage putting themselves against some of the most dangerous fighters on the planet for our entertainment. They are quite literally risking life and limb and making huge sacrifices outside the cage as well and this game simply wouldn't be possible if they didn't. To honour these brave fighters, every time one of them wins in for a real user (or users in this case) they get inducted into the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame! For winning the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game: 36th Edition for Jordan & Pippen (@qqqqqq & @Spockling ) It now gives me great pleasure to officially induct Robert Valentin into the Tapology Lucky Bastard Game Hall of Fame!
